plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.noWorkspace: Choose a Gateway and workspace to manage plugins.
plugins.empty: No plugins installed. Add a plugin archive to get started.
plugins.readOnly: Plugins are read-only with your current permissions.
plugins.loadFailed: Could not refresh plugins. Check your Gateway connection and try again.
plugins.archiveFailed: Could not prepare or upload the archive. Choose a .zip, .tar.gz or .tgz file under 256 MiB and try again.
plugins.staleAction: This action is unavailable or stale. Refresh the plugin before retrying.
plugins.stalePreview: The plugin changed after this preview. Select the archive again.
plugins.staleSelection: Selection is stale or unavailable. Remove it and select the current plugin explicitly.
plugins.updateNotice: Renames remove the old component and create a new one. Changed MCP settings may require sign-in again.
plugins.removed: This plugin was removed. Return to the list.
plugins.interruptedNotice: The unfinished operation blocks execution. Continue to repair it, or remove the plugin.
plugins.restoreNotice: This component was removed by you. Restoring creates an installation with package defaults. Previous settings or sign-in may not be retained.
plugins.retentionNotice: Plugin data is kept by default. Enable deletion only if you want to remove the plugin’s managed data directory.
plugins.removeNotice: Remove the plugin and its components. Plugin data will remain on the Gateway.
plugins.removePurgeNotice: Remove the plugin, its components and retained plugin data.
plugins.removeComponentNotice: The plugin will retain this removal. A future update will not restore the component without your consent.
plugins.configNotice: Enter one server body (command or URL with optional arguments, environment or headers). The existing installation name and identity are preserved.
plugins.callbackReceived: Callback received. Return to Plugins to check the Gateway authorization status.
plugins.callbackRejected: This callback is stale or does not match a pending sign-in. Return to Plugins and start sign-in again.
plugins.updateSkillNotice: Select a .tar.gz or .tgz skill archive. This sets an explicit native source override; plugin updates will preserve it.
plugins.offline: Gateway is offline. Connect to manage this plugin.
